scripts.dev: concurrently -n CLIENT,SERVER -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.setup: npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
